competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, category-specific, or refer to store credit/exchange rather than a full refund.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from the date of delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows a different return window, a different start date, no full refund for standard items, or that standard items are excluded from the 30-day full-refund policy.
